notes.title: Update on Our Sequel Development #5
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/55ea1f9c108892757ff4e61e8745413dd8e29a83.jpg"][/img]
Hello, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

We hope you’ve all been doing well.

Thanks to your continued support, we’ve been able to focus fully on the development of our upcoming title, Troubleshooter: Banished Children, and we sincerely thank you for that.

That said, we apologize for not being able to respond to your valuable feedback on the current game as promptly as we’d like. Once Banished Children is released and development reaches a more stable point, we promise to apply the experience and knowledge we’ve gained to improve the original game as well.

Now, we’d like to share with you the progress we’ve made on Troubleshooter: Banished Children over the past three months.

[/p][h2]1. Confirmation of the Main Character Concept[/h2][p]
We’ve reworked the initial concept designs of several key characters to better align with the story and worldbuilding.

The designs introduced below will serve as the characters’ default costumes during gameplay.

[/p][h3](1) Azul: Traditional / Casual Outfit[/h3][p]
In his village, Azul prefers wearing traditional attire designed for the warm climate—lightweight, quick-drying, and well-ventilated clothing that allows him to enter the water at any time with ease.

However, when heading outside the village, he opts for casual outfits from Bonaparte, a luxury fashion brand from Valhalla known for blending style and practicality.

Among his favorites is a special outfit personally designed by Eunomia, Bonaparte’s lead designer. Tailored specifically for ESP users, this outfit offers exceptional flexibility and functionality—making it Azul’s most cherished choice for outings.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/9274fc4277f8de7bc80fc6b571b08f34dde10261.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h3](2) Feye: Monastic / Casual Outfit[/h3][p]
Faye was taken in by the Silvermoon Order at a young age and spent most of her early years in the monastery, wearing simple training robes. These robes were nearly identical in form and texture, with only their size changing as she grew.

However, during a pilgrimage, Faye met Aurora and began traveling with her group. Aurora, who had an infectious passion for fashion, constantly suggested new outfits for Faye to try. Though Faye was indifferent at first, she eventually gave in to Aurora’s persistent enthusiasm.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/c986580b225f39f1bc0bd4716c28e177a3f6ad92.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h3](3) Claudia: Casual / Outdoor Outfit[/h3][p]
Claudia typically wears a loose, long dress skirt paired with a short blouse—an outfit that keeps her comfortable and mobile throughout all seasons. Although Aurora often suggests different clothing styles, Claudia consistently and firmly turns her down.

On the rare occasions when she goes out, Claudia puts on a long, flowing black fabric coat. Aurora often complains not only about Claudia’s stubborn taste in fashion, but also about her tendency to choose only dark-colored clothes. Still, Claudia remains unmoved.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/b7b21d06502625ce390970dab352284f32e56a60.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h2]2. New Animation Motion Added[/h2][p]
In Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children, our limited development capabilities sometimes led to unintuitive and inconvenient character movement.

For example, characters often had to take unnecessarily long routes around low fences, or perform multiple jumps to get over low cover objects.

To address these issues, we’ve adopted several new movement actions from Firaxis’ XCOM series, which served as a major reference during the development of Abandoned Children.

[/p][h3](1) Jumping over an obstacle in a single move[/h3][p]
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/LGmMBQV.gif"][/img]
[/p][h3](2) Jumping over a fence in a single move[/h3][p]
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/28g5OyI.gif"][/img]
[/p][h3](3) Climbing a ladder[/h3][p]
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/05Icd5G.gif"][/img]
These movement actions not only make navigation more intuitive, but also add depth to tactical decision-making during combat. We're designing the game with these elements in mind to enhance strategic enjoyment.

[/p][h2]3. New BGMs[/h2][p]
As with our previous development update, three new tracks have been added over the past three months.

We’ll continue doing our best to bring you more enjoyment through great music!

[/p][h3](1) Beyond the Ember[/h3][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="v6R8eDc4gy4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][h3](2) Reed[/h3][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="P8XXn6otBVI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][h3](3) Azul[/h3][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="A50s7CEH8Ug;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][h2]4. Regarding Future Development Plans[/h2][p]
We are currently in the process of creating the key assets for Troubleshooter: Banished Children, including player characters, enemies, and NPCs. Once this phase is complete, we will begin filling in the core gameplay content in earnest.

When a playable portion of the game reaches a sufficient level of completion, we plan to launch Early Access. As with our previous title, we will continue to build out the game's content during Early Access while using the revenue to support ongoing development.

Although we are a small team with limited resources and a slower development pace, we'll do our best to deliver a more refined and enjoyable SRPG experience.

Thank you for your continued support.[/p]

notes.title: Update on Our Sequel Development #4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/72f70cc6664732aa758542b88c0441904d7adc9e.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

We’re here to share another update on the development progress of 'Troubleshooter: Banished Children' over the past three months!

[h2]1. Confirmation of the Main Character Concept[/h2]

We have reworked some of our character concept arts to better fit our current setting and storyline.

The following two costumes will be used as the default outfits for Aurora and Hannah.

We'll do our best to bring other costumes to life as well.

[h3](1) Aurora's Summer/Winter Outfits[/h3]

Aurora, who lives in the remote Kalter Mountains, occasionally gets second-hand clothes through Gravis, who visits Dragonscale Market. However, among them, the ones that come from Valhalla are rare treasures, hard to come by in Kalter. To Aurora, these clothes hold a special meaning.

She has three favorites. The first is a T-shirt from the ‘Hero Irene’ fan club, carrying the mark of the hero she admires. The second is a vest featuring DINGs, the trio of villains from an animated series—lightweight and easy to move in, perfect for active wear. Lastly, her warm and cozy VHPD winter jacket. For Aurora, it is an essential item to survive the harsh winter cold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/b7d4289d632bf489bbe2461fcf59ebeba3b569fa.jpg[/img]

[h3](2) Hannah' Battle/Casual Outfits[/h3]

Hannah, born in the Frosthorn Tribe of northern Kalter Mountains, had worn garments made from Ummer hide since childhood. Ummer hide was an exceptional insulating material, perfectly suited for enduring the region’s harsh cold. For Hannah and her tribe, it was not just essential for survival but an inseparable part of daily life.

However, the second-hand clothes from Valhalla that Aurora handed her felt like relics from another world. Thin, lightweight fabric, vibrant colors, and unrestricted designs—everything about them was unfamiliar and strange.

Even so, Hannah chose to embrace change. No matter how awkward or embarrassing it felt, she believed this challenge was a small yet significant step toward the new life she had chosen beyond the tribe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/4a94e1f90df37030dd59f7d47ba28ca6824eebc1.jpg[/img]


[h2]2. Works on Portraits[/h2]

The character portraits, which were used to depict our character’s emotions and personality, are also going to be used in our sequel.

With these, we hope to present you with a better representation of each character’s personality, and deeper immersion to our stories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/cc7f9abed14cd187b453798cfb3b40962f955980.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/3035d721346bb6afd0e3065e5dd6573738185030.jpg[/img]


[h2]3. Works on the New 3D Models[/h2]

Since early this year, we’ve been creating 3D models for our new characters. As we adapt to a new rendering method, we’ve encountered many challenges and iterations. Because of this, we plan to work on our main characters later in the development schedule. For now, we are focusing on modeling NPCs and enemy characters, as they are relatively less demanding.

Additionally, some characters from our previous titles who will be returning in the sequel are being redesigned to align with the new visual style.

We fully understand that this new style may feel unfamiliar or different from what some fans expected. However, we are continuously refining it to ensure it resonates with as many players as possible. Thank you for your support!

[h3]Frosthorn Tribe Female Variation[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/1c2ae77ee4875367bbf8261b8e383b7d8c32143a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Frosthorn Tribe Male Variation[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/6127448dc51d982911024e5fdade77ceb0190ee4.jpg[/img]

[h3]Unique NPCs[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/6fd047d8c17ee36b8592d6f766350ddb02a7e261.jpg[/img]


[h2]4. New BGM[/h2]

Just like the latest update, we got another 3 new tracks for the last 3 months!

We'll do our best to bring you even more joy with great music!

# Condemnation

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rDAoqyKsQXk

# Aurora

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nqgVOAkpcU4

# Witch of Dawn

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yqFE0gW9tZo

And that’s all for today’s update!

We’ll see you in our next update with more and better news.

Thank you.

notes.title: Art Book of "White Lion and Black Witch" Release Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/0bc1b94461b0745c4e291ce3c96ffb3c631ad646.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! This is the Troubleshooter Development team.

We added an Art Book for "White Lion and Black Witch" and a bundle called "Troubleshooter: Art Collection" on Steam. The Art Collection includes all of our released Artbook and OST so on.


[h3]1. About the Art Book of "White Lion and Black Witch"[/h3]

The Art Book of "White Lion and Black Witch" is a total of 116 pages, and will be sold at $4.99.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856370/TROUBLESHOOTER_Abandoned_Children__White_Lion_and_Black_Witch__Digital_Art_Book/

Unlike the former one that we had released, this Art Book fully includes the development process and the draft for new character costumes that the development team has been recently working on.

We will invest all our profits from Art Book in creating more various costumes. And with the profits from our new costumes, we will repay you with joy by investing them into more content updates.


[h3]2. About "Troubleshooter: Art Collection" Bundle[/h3]

We have released a bundle set that includes Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children and our free DLC "White Lion and Black Witch" with all the Art Book and OST released so far. It will always give you a 10% discount on the total price.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24855/TROUBLESHOOTER_Art_Collection/

If you purchase the Art Collection, you can get the Art Book and OST that you haven't bought for a 10% discounted price. Anyone willing to buy all the new Art books and OST can save their money by purchasing the Art Collection.


[h3]3. Information of current development state[/h3]

Please accept our apologies for only announcing new merchandise but not another DLC.

For now, the development team is working on a new content called "The Joint Training"

"The Joint Training" is composed of "Single Player PVE mode" and "PVP mode". In PVE mode, you can create your own team and fight 8 enemies. You can even freely compete with other players with the PVP mode.

We are planning to update "The Joint Training" in march. We will bring you more information with a detailed development roadmap when our new content gets more concrete shape later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/44be74049f0f46fc5bf38c8d9571649bec4d3a77.jpg[/img]
< We are referring to the latest popular MOBA games for developing the character selection of "The Joint Training" ːDumplingː >

Since Korea is experiencing a sudden increase of patients with COVID-19, our development has been delayed due to quarantine.

We are truly sorry again for all those who are waiting for new content for our game since we didn't come up with any news.

We'll give our best to be a better development team for Troubleshooter.

Thank you very much.

notes.title: [News] New OST release and extra tracks to the existing DLC
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/21ad3f2aa94f9596439494369834359bd23e1424.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, this is the Troubleshooter development team

Have you all been doing well?

Thanks to your support, the "White Lion and Black Witch" DLC development was completed last year.

Today, I have brought news about new OST release and extra tracks to the existing OST.

[h3]About release of the "White Lion and Black Witch" OST[/h3]

When we released the first DLC, the dev team was sorry to the gamers that all tracks could not be included in the OST due to the copyright of the tracks.

In order to include all the tracks used in the DLC in the OST, the development team went through a process of consulting with copyright holders about the track sources that the development team did not have copyrights.

The release of the OST was delayed by two months due to copyright consultation and additional payment. We're sorry that we couldn't proceed with work faster.
( * ( * Sound sources provided by some copyright holders do not support the FLAC format. For this reason, some tracks are provided in MP3 format. ) )

This OST contains a total of 27 tracks and costs 4.99$.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856390

The proceeds from the release of the OST will be reinvested to give you more pleasure with better tracks.

Thank you.

There have been steady requests to add these tracks to the OST and the dev team also wanted the OST can include tracks as much as possible. So the dev team contacted the copyright holders of each track source directly.

However, despite our efforts, copyrights of some tracks were managed by publishers and were not allowed to be used in OST. The dev team would like to apologize to those who wanted all the songs to be added to the OST.

The development team is developing Joint Training as well as DLC. ( PvP & PvE )

Through the system, you can train with the police units or other trouble shooter companies.

This content is a system that fights with units of the same size as my unit, not a few to many battles that we've experienced a lot in the Scenario Missions and the Violent Cases of the game.
 
The system will be available to users who use offline mode through NPC, and users who use online mode will be able to apply for Joint Training directly from the Shooter Street to other users.

Joint Training was originally designed exclusively for online mode. 

However, since the official launch of the game, the actual number of players has not been so many and the player-to-player battle may not be active.

Therefore, we design it as a system that can be used alone in online mode and can be compensated accordingly. Based on this, we are also making it available in offline mode.

Joint Training will be subject to improvement and further updates even after DLC development is completed.

For example, we are also planning to update the Beast Match or Drone Match that is using your own beasts and drones.

The development team knows that the scenario missions and the violent case are more attractive than this kind of content for many people.

Nevertheless, the development team decided to challenge the possibility of online mode rather than abandon online content.
 
We will continue to improve and manage this challenge to produce good results.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/03c980eb53eb12d6a3dd90bd95ea8b55dc9798a0.jpg[/img]

[h4]3. The Next DLC[/h4]

The development team is thinking about whether we can develop the next season "Troubleshooter: Banished Children", as DLC, which is currently under development, enters the completion stage.
 
In particular, the biggest concern is whether to continue the story in the form of an expansion pack like MMO or make it a new game.
 
And most of all, we can afford to maintain the current situation, but we are very vulnerable to new challenges in terms of finance.
 
After consideration, we are considering developing additional DLCs that add new scenario missions, enemies, and systems after completing "White Lion and Black Witch" DLC.

It's sad news for those who are looking forward to the next season, but we will continue to talk about "Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children" by developing a new DLC and improving the game itself.

If we can lay the foundation for a new challenge through this process, we will definitely develop "Troubleshooter: Banished Children".

I'm sure many of you don't like this decision, but we'll do our best to repay you with fun content.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Notice] The Announcement of the Next Update Schedule
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/1abe0eb4b7570c841f7ca632311c2fe4dad2e55e.jpg[/img]


Hello everyone, this is the Troubleshooter dev team.

First of all, we would like to thank you all for enjoying our game.

Today, we would like to announce the situation of the dev team ask for your understanding.

Last summer, the dev team tried to focus on developing the game, but the result was far from what we have planned. As a result, Troubleshooter has not had an update for about two months. However, we are planning to update our first DLC [b]Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children – White Lion and Black Witch[/b] on [b]November 16, P.M 11(GMT + 9)[/b].

We are going to release the DLC for free hence there will be no extra charges. We originally planned for Bianca and Alisa to join Albus in the main episode, but due to the development schedule, we were unable to do so. [b]White Lion and Black Witch[/b] is a story about Bianca and Alisa. The episode will be playable after you finish the main episode: [b]Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children[/b].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/f2e989ec4c26529b309cea7d89d8efaae2794350.jpg[/img]


[h3]1. Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children – White Lion and Black Witch DLC update schedule[/h3]

We have been planning to release the DLC earlier but have kept you waiting for a long time due to our lack of ability. We are deeply sorry about that. Currently, we have completed the base work, but we still have scenario missions and translations to do.

For the above reason, on November 16, we will be going to update the first mission of DLC, which will be a story about how Bianca and Alisa join Albus. After then, for every one to two weeks, we will be going to update the scenario mission. There will be a total of 8 scenario missions and one violent case.
We understand that you have been waiting for an update for a long time. The dev team has failed to meet the deadline. We are deeply sorry about it. However, we thought releasing playable content that is not fully prepared is the worst choice we can make. The dev team concluded to choose quality over quantity.

After we finish updating the DLC, new illustrations and BGM will be updated to the art book and the soundtrack.

We apologize for the inconvenience we brought despite all your support.

[b]Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children – White Lion and Black Witch DLC content guide[/b]
- 9 scenario missions (Last scenario mission of chapter 6 + all scenario missions of chapter 7)
- 1 violent case
- Level 50 items
- New mastery and systems


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/8f14aa9730a771c3060fbe24f7b29d3c8185158c.jpg[/img]


[h3]2. Troubleshooter: Banished Children update schedule[/h3]

There is no project running at the moment. Thanks to your support, we have been able to develop our [b]Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children[/b] this year. However, developing [b]Troubleshooter: Banished Children[/b] will take at least a year, judging by the dev team’s capability.

For us, a year is a very long time. There are too many factors to consider; including the fact that we might not be able to maintain the dev team. Therefore, we cannot promise you when we will start the project. To resolve anxiety factors, we are going to mainly focus on improving [b]Troubleshooter: Abandoned Children[/b]. We are going to improve the content and add more quests and additional elements to make the game richer.

We are sorry to let you down with the news. We will find a way to start the project [b]Troubleshooter: Banished Children[/b] as soon as we finish updating the DLC.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/e00e507525f8f096919bc77d863861130d63aac7.jpg[/img]


[h3]3. About online content[/h3]

The dev team was planning to make Troubleshooter an online game with a short story. However, going through early access, a lot of you wanted us to work on the level of completion of the game as a single play game. The dev team agreed on the idea and thus worked on improving the quality. This, however, turned out to be the reason for the failure of the dev team to provide the majority of the promised online content.

On one thought, we thought of giving up the online content. However, we believe that co-op and PVP can provide extra playable content to those who have completed the game. Therefore, we are going to work on the online part when we have the time and capacity to do it. Nonetheless, we are going to primarily focus on the DLC and online content will come after we finish updating the DLC.

We apologize to those who had been waiting for the online content.

Thank you very much.

notes.title: Proofreading Tool manual version 2
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone, this is Troubleshooter development team.

First of all,

From the time when we released the Proofreading Tool, many Troubleshooter community members gladly provided their ideas and better translations. 

I wanted to take this opportunity to say thank you to all of them. 

Many requests to the tool has been received. We tried to apply them and many functions have been added. This is why we update the new manual.[/b]

Troubleshooter is supporting 3 languages officially and other languages are supported by unofficially. 

The team also knows that some of official translation is not such a readable. We're sorry about that.

Though the team is made up with developers and no foreign language expert, we can't give up updating the translation. 

This is why we built the Proofreading Tool. We wanted to provide you a more convenient way to access translation of the game.

Did you find out any typos, awkward expressions, or unreadable sentences? You can suggest better translation by using Proofreading Tool.

Every single suggested translation will be checked by development team and there will be a chance to share the idea of translation with other users.

We'll do our best to apply the translations you've made in the update as soon as we possible.

Why don't you join translation of Troubleshooter? :D

+ [b]If you want to join the translation, internet connection is essential.[/b]

+ [b]How to activate Proofreading Tool[/b]

Steam LIBRARY → HOME → right click Troubleshooter → Properties → Click [ SET LAUNCH OPTIONS ] on [ GENERAL ] → type [ --translation volunteer ] into the popup screen and click enter → Launch Troubleshooter

+ To deactivate Proofreading Tool, remove the [ --translation volunteer ] in the [ SET LAUNCH OPTIONS ].

[h2]Editing Dialogues[/h2]

Step 1. 
Once you activate the tool, you can see [ Support Translation ] on the bottom left corner of the game screen when a dialogue is being progressed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/735ffd9c3806c6dd19ec15703fac1373e4fb0093.jpg[/img]

Step 2. 
Click the [ Support Translation ], then [ Translation List ] window pops up. [b]This is the main screen of Proofreading tool[/b]. Please check the number mark on the screenshot and descriptions below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/6f2081269806334efbcdb8712103054a2209d981.jpg[/img]

1.) [b]Category tab: [/b]
- Mastery, Ability, Item, Buff: Regardless of what currently being listed on the screen, you can always edit names and descriptions of a specific mastery, ability, item and buff.
- Search Text: You can search sentences that include the words you've input.
- Recent Text: When you click the [ Support Translation ], main screen shows this as its default. This shows dialogues history.

2.) [b]Content box: [/b]
- Shows contents of the category you've chosen on the Category tab.

3.) [b]Page navigator: [/b]
- When the contents are too many, you can navigate them using Previous and Next buttons.

4.) [b]Keyword search box: [/b]
- If you want to look for any text that is included to Mastery, Ability, Item, Buff, you can type a specific word here and the result will be showed if there is any.

Step 3. 
If you find awkward sentences or typos in a specific sentence, click the sentence you want to edit then screen turns to the [b]edit mode[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/5492897d5eec5574ad707768ce162c10de593959.jpg[/img]

1.) [b]Current Translation:[/b] The sentence you've clicked.

2.) [b]New Translation:[/b] You can write your translation here.

3.) [b]Note:[/b] Besides the New Translation, if you want to tell anything that is related to your new translation to the development team, you can freely leave the message here. The text here won't be included to the text in New Translation section.

4.) [b]Translation History:[/b] Lists the confirmed translations.

5.) [b]Other Suggestions:[/b] If anyone already suggested new translation and it is not confirmed yet, they are listed here. You can still suggest your own translation and instead of writing new one, you can click heart icon in already suggested translation list. The sentence that has higher 'heart' count will have a higher chance to be confirmed by the development team.

6.) [b]Language:[/b] Set the language of you've input.

Once you've input new translation or click any heart icon, please don't forget to click 'Submit'.

[h2]Editing Masteries, Abilities, Items, and Buffs[/h2]

Step 1. 
In the main screen, click the Mastery(or Ability or Item or Buff) tab. ( 1 in below screenshot )
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/5559b918605d6f88c062ac8e73ffdcff5d2b9332.jpg[/img]

Step 2. 
All other steps are same as Editing Dialogues.

* [b]Warning[/b]

You can see the Placeholder when you click some sentences. ( 2 in above screenshot )

For example, a sentence before you clicked could be showed like below.

『 Hit Chance increases by 1.5% per 1 currently applied Scholar, Hacker masteries. 』

But once you clicked, it will be showed like below in the edit mode.

『 $Stat$ increases by $Value2$ per $Value$ currently applied $Type$, $Type2$ masteries. 』

As you have already noticed, $Stat$, $Value$, $Value2$, $Type$, $Type2$ are placeholder. It is automatically replaced to the pre setup value when it is used in the game. You can move placeholder's position but if placeholder's format has broken, It won't be replaced to right value and it will be showed as error.

Of course all the suggested translations are checked by the development team and most error will be fixed. But please note that keep the placeholder's format right.

Thank you very much.

notes.title: [Notice] Update and Maintenance Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/ec8c4b64725e9ced3391953f80bf6790426851fa.jpg[/img]

Greetings, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

We understand that many of you are undergoing a hard time due to numerous natural disasters and COVID-19. How are you all fairing?

Thanks to your help and support, the development team has been working on game development.

The financial predicament, which many people concerned about, will pose no problems until the end of the year thanks to regular and summer sales.

We are grateful for all your support. We understand that our game has many flaws. The development team will do its best to compensate for all the love and support you gave. 

The following list is the first interim report of what we promised.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/932084d87ccf5de203bc23ac5c965ab40f2c353c.jpg[/img]
[h3]Additional Scenario[/h3]
We planned to update the additional scenario content, for which many of you requested and anticipated, by the end of the third quarter. However, our team is simultaneously developing existing content and additional content. The speed of development is not as fast as we expected.

This scenario will add one chapter (8 scenario missions) to the game after the ending. We are planning to release it by the end of September.

We thought of releasing the missions one by one, instead of the whole chapter at once. However, we understand that this might give new users the impression that the game is incomplete, and thus we currently have no plan to release the game in such fashion. 

However, the schedule and update method can change at any moment. Feel free to suggest your thoughts; we will contemplate your requests.


[h3]Partial controller support[/h3]
We received a lot of requests regarding the controller. The development team understands its dire need. However, implementing controller demands lots of requirements such as new UI, conveniences, etc. 

We have not had experience with controllers, and thus we are undergoing a lot of trials and errors. 

We are going to do our best to improve your experience with the controller in our game.


[h3]Online Community[/h3]
We have set the extension in online function as a long term goal. Our primary goal is to complete making the online community. Once we stabilize the game content, we are going to develop expansive content.

Many contents are delayed due to our lack of capability. We are deeply sorry for the inconvenience it caused.


[h3]Continous Feedback Reflection[/h3]
The development team is grateful for your feedback.

The members of the dev team are contemplating to reflect your feedback to satisfy all of the gamers. 

However, during this process, we understand that you can be frustrated by the dev team's slow feedback and persistence. Furthermore, some of our decision could have let you down.

The inconveniences are due to our lack of capability. Hence, we are trying to find a better way to resolve and reflect your feedback. 

Looking back into our days in development, we can feel that Dandylion is still nothing but a small and incapable development team.

However, to repay for your support and love, we will grow to be a better team to provide you with better game content. 

Thank you for your supports despite slow updates.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: [Notice] The price changes caused by bypass purchases in some countries.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/79ab56f669ae6b22706afb155f1ba463a064ef5b.jpg[/img]

First of all, We are sorry to inform you of this.

While we were checking from our official release sales until now, games were sold a lot in countries where people rarely purchased from early access to official releases.

At first, We thought this was an influx of users from new countries, but we realized through our player's report that most of them were bypass purchases that changed the national settings of Steam accounts.

We didn't have a way to stop this and Steam's recommended way was to raise prices if there were no sales in such countries. So after careful consideration of this, we made the following decision. 

We confirm that the recently released "XCOM:Chimera squad" is at a similar price to ours (a little cheaper than ours), and decide to raise the game prices in the country below to the price levels they set.

We apologize to the national users who are suffering from this.

If this price setting is unfair, please stop purchasing for a while. The price change can be changed again after 30 days, so we will consider it if you give us a lot of information to worry about.

[b]The price below has been changed the same as "XCOM:Chimera squad".[/b]
[list][*] Russian Rubles
[*] Brazilian Reals
[*] Indonesian Rupiah
[*] Malaysian Ringgit
[*] Philippine Peso
[*] Thai Baht
[*] Vietnamese Dong
[*] Turkish Lira
[*] Ukrainian Hryvnia
[*] Norwegian Krone
[*] Indian Rupee
[*] South African Rand
[*] Argentine Peso
[*] Kazakhstani Tenge
[*] SASIA - USD
[*] Mexican Peso
[*] Chilean Peso[/list]
The rest of the country remains unchanged.

We're really sorry to tell you this and We'll do our best to make a careful decision on this. 

Changes in prices will be applied after the steam is approved. 

Steam's approval will take some time and it will be the same as the previous price by then.

We're so sorry about that.

** Price Updated ** 

[h3]All of the above currency prices have been applied.[/h3]
[b]Note[/b]
The price of Ukrainian Hryvnia was entered abnormally because we made a mistake in the price change process. Thirty days after price changes are not changed and summer sales exist. We will normalize the call after that.  We're so sorry to Ukrainian users!!

notes.title: [Notice] Troubleshooter - Official release !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/a7ed92d478b4bb278c440c72f2ca09c42cd847fe.jpg[/img]

Greetings, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

Troubleshooter is finally getting full-released.

We would like to thank all of you who enjoyed our game during Early Access and all who waited for our game to be full-released.

Your supports were the driving force that kept us going.

With the full release, we would like to announce the henceforth schedule regarding game management and development.
 
[b]1. Regular update and additional playable contents[/b]

For a while, we are going to update the game every 1 to 2 weeks. Update intervals may vary according to the contents we are working on.
The major focuses are adding multi-playing contents, improving game experiences, optimization, partial support of game pad, and lastly, improving single-playing contents.

 
[b]2. DLC to raise funds[/b]

Hello, everyone. This is the Troubleshooter development team.

The development team is currently working on an ending scenario mission, fixing bugs, and applying your suggestions for translation. However, with all the work the development team is working on and due to our lack of people and capacity, we will not be able to full release on April 13th.

Due to our lack of capacity, we are putting our full release date off to [b]April 22nd.[/b]

We are deeply sorry.

According to the change of schedule, we are planning to make regular updates on April 11th and 18th and will put our full effort to make the best out of our game along the way.

All of the inconveniences you are experiencing are the result of our lack of capacity. We once again apologize and would like to remind you that we are deeply sorry for the current situation.

[b]Date:[/b] Saturday, April 11th / Saturday, April 18th

- Saturday 17:00 ~ 19:00 JST

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/073d09eaea11536380d5e80d537ca648e49be781.jpg[/img]

We would also like to inform you of some matters the development team faces regarding full release.

[b]1. Development after full release[/b]
After full release, we will be focusing on improving inconveniences in the game and making up for the lack of game contents for a while. We will try our best to maintain the period of regular updates.
In long terms, we are going to add multi-play in some parts, partial applications of game pad, and contents we promised during early access. We will announce the development schedule regarding the above features later through road map.

[b]2. New character[/b]
As soon as our first goal is achieved, we are going to update untold stories of episode 1. And through that, you will be able to get a new character as your company. We will also inform you of this as soon as we have it scheduled out.

notes.title: [Notice] Announcing the date of Official Release and Road Maps.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/f23d213ac4fe2668a26d4fc276da62128eeaf64d.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

We have planned to officially release Troubleshooter on April 13, 2020.

The road map we have planned to achieve before the release is shown below.[/b]
 
[h3][b]March Road Map[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Add quests in Shooter Street available up to level 40
[*] Add a Valkyrie shop. (You can purchase unique items that you missed out during missions)
Add scenario mission
[*] Extend company masteries and add effects according to the level of the company
[*] Apply as much user feedback as possible[/list] 
[h3][b]April Road Map[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Optimization and bug fixes
[*] Game trailer renewal
[*]Digital Artbook
[*]Apply as much user feedback as possible[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/a7ed92d478b4bb278c440c72f2ca09c42cd847fe.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Everyone who showed interests and concerns for Troubleshooter.[/b][/h3]
Troubleshooter has been available on Steam as Early Access for two years and three months. Today, we would like to talk a little about ourselves.
 
We organized team DANDYLION in an attempt to create a turn-based RPG and were able to receive feedback during the Early Access. Thanks to your support, we could share an idea and communicate for better developments. The last two years have been a great pleasure for us.
 
Our beginning was trifling.
[list][*] 2 playable characters and 6 scenario stages
[*] Less than 100 Steam reviews 4 months since Early Access
[*] Only 80% positive reviews[/list]  
However, thanks to all of your consistent participation and support during Early Access, we were able to update our game 74 times for the last two years. And Troubleshooter has seen improvements as follows.
[list][*] 9 playable characters
[*] 41 scenario missions
[*] 22 recurring quests and 10 violent case missions
[*] More than 200 cut scenes
[*] 900 masteries, modules, additional masteries
[*] Additional contents such as class changing, beast taming, crafting drones, foods
More than 1,500 Steam reviews
[*] 90% positive reviews[/list]
We sometimes had frustrating times. We even wanted to let go of our project. Nonetheless, your feedback and support kept us motivated. If it weren’t for all of you, our games would not have existed. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/f7a259278c190692f16906168e328251547a1a80.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Regarding the decision to full release and to increase the price...[/b][/h3]
 
Despite your support and devotions from all our team members, Troubleshooter development team has been suffering difficulties in maintaining the team for a long time. Furthermore, each member spent more than five years for this project and we have come to the point in which mere desires and attachment for the game cannot hold us together.
 
For the above reasons, we are properly releasing the game along with the last scenario mission of the first episode.
 
We are properly releasing Troubleshooter despite its shortcomings. We will put all our efforts to improve the upcoming scenario mission and insufficient content to make a better Troubleshooter experience.

Moreover, starting on March 12th, we are planning to increase the price to [b]25$[/b] to raise funds for game development.
 
We understand that many of you will not be happy about our decision of increasing the price for an incomplete game. We will do our best to make Troubleshooter worthy of the price by the time we release it properly.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31614849/5afe9e2abb65397234646fce96b7ba070eb43570.jpg[/img]
  
[h3][b]We are going to take every chance to carry on with the game development after the full release.[/b][/h3]

Our main goal is to maintain the team and finish our project, Troubleshooter. This, in our opinion, is the only way to make up for all the support we have received from you.
 
If we raise enough funds by the full release, we are looking forward to improving the pre-existing content, introducing various characters and classes, adding episode two, and lastly, portraying untold back-stories of our characters.
 
Furthermore, we are planning to put a digital artbook and OST on sale to raise funds.
 
We all think that such circumstances are a growing pain that indie game development studios undergo to mature: something that we should definitely overcome.
 
The full release of Troubleshooter has flaws but we will invest the utmost efforts to continue on with developing.
 
Thank you.

notes.title: [Notice] Update schedule announcement - 4th March, 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/e49ec095ea1fb37988a036d5978b26cfd9a3bb02.jpg[/img]

Hello, this is Troubleshooter Development team.

[b]First of all, it has been decided that the update that was planned today will be postponed to this Friday. [/b]

[list]
[*] Friday 12:00 ~ 14:00 UTC
[*] Friday 04:00 ~ 06:00 PST 
[*] Friday 13:00 ~ 15:00 CET
[*] Friday 21:00 ~ 23:00 KST (GMT+9)
[/list]

We are sincerely sorry for the frequent update delays. However, we would like to explain the reasons for our delay in the update.

After Giselle joined the team, beasts became available in the office. We are hoping for the beasts to provide a new type of entertainment to the users.

A number of users have left us with valuable feedbacks for the past 2 weeks and the development team considered many opinions regarding the beasts.

We have discussed whether the beasts should be treated as just a factor of Giselle’s hunter class or treated as teammates that provide new types of enjoyment in the office.

Our conclusion was to make the beasts to provide new types of enjoyment in the office and we have decided to add the following contents.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/493b64b1b0796b6567555ce1ae92b9f6b3899904.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]1. Changes in Hunter Class Masteries[/b][/h1]
Hunter’s personalized mastery ‘Taming’ will be substituted with another mastery and it will be changed from Hunter’s personalized mastery to Hunter class ability.

With this change, beast taming and summoning/releasing will be available regardless to Giselle’s job.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/bd2d7cb7dbea685a5f4b295d10baf5f263889641.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]2. Addition in Abilities and Decrease in Stats for the Beasts[/b][/h1]
Instead of fixed abilities, all beasts will be available to select abilities according to the user’s taste through ability formation like it is with other characters.

The new abilities will range from the abilities similar to those that the characters use to distinct abilities that emphasize the characteristics of the beasts.

However, since the beasts get stronger through ability addition, there will be 10 ~ 30% decrease in the stats in respect to the type and the level of the beasts.

Balance adjustment will not end with this update and will be further improved with feedbacks to provide better contents to the users.

Because we have decided to add the above contents in this update, the development team inevitably needed extra time and unfortunately had to postpone the update.
 
Once again, we are sorry for another late update.

We will focus on scenario updates again after this update!

Thank you.

Best Regards,

Troubleshooter Development Team

notes.title: [Notice] Announcement on Update Schedule - 21th.Sep.2018
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Troubleshooter development team.

We would like to announce our plans on development schedule and some plan changes.

[h1][b]1. Development Team Holiday[/b][/h1]

Five days of Korean Thanksgiving Day holiday starts from September 22nd in Korea. Korean Thanksgiving Day is one of the biggest National Holiday in Korea and separated family members tend to gather in one place during this holiday. 
Accordingly, all members of Troubleshooter development team is planning on resting during this period for better updates in the future. We are planning to only focus on resolving any serious issues that negatively affect the progress in playing the game during the holiday season. Please excuse us for this decision.

[h1][b]2. Update Period[/b][/h1]

We have promised for weekly updates with new missions with the start of Early Access. However, we have decided that it would be difficult to finish some process in translation and work on some other minor issues due to the holiday season in Korea from the end of September to the beginning of October(There are two national holidays - The National Foundation Day and Hangul Day - in first and second week of October in Korea.). 
For this reason, we would like to inform that our update period has changed to once in two weeks. We will announce again if weekly update becomes possible in the near future.

[h1][b]3. Next Update[/b][/h1]

Today update will be mainly on new masteries, balance adjustments, and bug fixes. We were planning on new scenario missions; however, our schedule was delayed due to updates on bugs fixes after the “Class Change” update. 
Next update is planned on first week October. Scenario missions will be provided in the next update. Please excuse us for above conditions.

Thank You.

Sincerely,

Troubleshooter Development Team.

notes.title: [Notice] Update Preview
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/3484e976c7135f752f3def5f0b422ce63db33a47.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, this is Troubleshooter development team.

First of all, we want to apologize for the  delaying update. [u][b]The update is getting ready and it would be applied next week the latest. [/b][/u]

Many users are asking questions regarding the update. Hence, the development team thought that some catch ups should be done before the main update.

We are going to introduce the contents we are currently working on and some future plans we have on Troubleshooter.

[h1][b] * The following plans are still in the progress of development. The contents could be changed. Please excuse us that the contents are not yet translated and are only provided in Korean. [/b][/h1]

* [b]Contents Currently being Developed:[/b] 

1. [b]Class Change[/b]

- We are developing a class change system that could bring a dynamic change to character growth. Characters should be level 20 or above to change class.

Two more new classes would be opened to each character and class could be changed at any moment when the player wants. For example, Albus could choose ‘Great Swordman’ and change to ‘Magic Knight’. However, some costs would be required to change class.

Basic ability would increase and new class abilities would be activated when class is changed. Also, additional mastey slots could be unlocked depending on different classes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/3b91b80fcbb9e593bcdc4b5559b9e82c7cecda26.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/e348cd3139d5667cae029175a09f6e2c462354d8.jpg[/img]

2. [b]Additional Abilities[/b]

An ability would be unlocked for every 10 levels. This would make up some of the character’s weaknesses.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/6694cc6c9596d4ac4cea3ef8690732cd0f2506c8.jpg[/img]

When abilities are expanded, abilities used in missions could be edited. Abilities are divided into 3 different types: Basic, General, and SP. The number of ability types that could be equipped varies depending on the character.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/c41018a1a9647f3650643da101cefa1b37210649.jpg[/img]
Albus can equip 3 general abilities but can only equip 1 SP ability.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/afa177635fc5e4b4a9af765e67028728f95a6027.jpg[/img]
Anne has one less ‘general ability’ slot but has one more ‘SP ability’ slot. Therefore, she has more choices during overcharged state.

The followings are abilities for new classes that are in development state now.
( * We apologize for us not being able to show all new abilities due to upload storage size issues. )
( * There are a total of 8 gif files with each of them having considerably big file size. It may take some time to show all of them. )

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/uVj7HnnLMFhndBi7D3/giphy.gif[/img]
Albus: Storm Slash, Attack nearby targets with powerful continuous slash.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1dMqwYrPvHfgQnwd69/giphy.gif[/img]
Albus: Wind Walk, It is possible to get out from dangerous districts or traverse long paths.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YlyOAIKFKcufHUw6KD/giphy.gif[/img]
Sion: Flash Missile, Allows Sion to focus more on ranged battles.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1ipjiegX88xGiZbnSj/giphy.gif[/img]
Sion: Flash Beam, Gives significant damage to all enemies in straight line.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/QfJZZBoolQWWUvW3Ke/giphy.gif[/img]
Irene: Flame Explosion, It would be a great chance for Irene, who didn’t have any AOEs.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/2fVxwnMa4ddpL6iPRq/giphy.gif[/img]
Irene: Taking the Bull by the Horns, It is possible to make Irene as a melee attack specialist.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1YdmGjXvDqEQwapR8r/giphy.gif[/img]
Anne: Starlight Prison, Lock up the target completely. The target is impossible to move or attack and the target locked up in starlight prison doesn't receive any damages.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/cdIbIOFehiEp87fIqL/giphy.gif[/img]
Anne: Pouring Starlight Arrows, A total of 12 starlight arrows randomly attack surrounding enemies. If there’s only one enemy, then all arrows will be concentrated on that enemy.

( * Heixing is currently under developing.)

* [b]Future plans on development: [/b]

1. New member: We are preparing a fifth member to the company. Character selection and scenario missions for this character is under consideration.

2. Lobby System: A lobby is a place for users to gather up and communicate with each other. You can have conversations and even buy items from various NPCs. Moreover, quest system and item exchange among users are planned after the lobby system is patched.

Again, we are sorry that our update is getting delayed. We will comeback with various high quality contents in return.

Thank you.

Hello everyone, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

We announce the maintenance schedule and update details.

[b]Scenario mission is still under developing. It'll be provided through additional update in this week.
We're so sorry for those who are waiting for it.[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Daylight saving time is not applied.[/b]
[*] Date: 1st, August, 2018
[*] Maintenance and update time will be announced with separate notice right after the schedule has been fixed.
[/list]

[b]Update details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Set masteries have been added. (Screen shot will be added in next notice.)
[list]
[*] Names of set masteries could be changed.
[*] "Suppression"
[*] "Legendary worker"
[/list]
[*] New difficulty levels have been added.
[list]
[*] [b]Safe(New): Very few amount of elite monsters. The Enemy AI takes more passive stance during their turn[/b]
[*] Easy: Not changed.
[*] Normal: Not changed.
[*] Hard: Not changed.
[*] [b]Cruel(New): If the monster has its elite type, only the elite type of the monster will be spawned.[/b]
[/list]
[*] Challenge mode has been added.
[list]
[*] It is applied to repetable mission in 'Mission Control' and 'Case Record'.
[*] In the 'Challenge mode', the enemy levels are increased to match the highest player character level who joins the mission.
[*] The enemies gain additional random masteries as their levels increase.
[/list]
[*] System option 'Simplify Mastery Acquirment Notice' has been added.
[list]
[*] If you get mastery it does not stop the mission process and just display simple notification.
[/list]

[*] The amount of the inventory space count gained when you contract the warehouse will be increased from 100 to 200.
[list]
[*] If you already have contracted the warehouse, inventory count will be added automatically after this update.
[/list]
[*] Regeneration rate of the buff Regeneration has been increased from 3.33% to 15%. This will affect to below masteries.
[list]
[*] Fire Blessing, Ice Blessing, Lightning Blessing, Wind Blessing, Water Blessing, Earth Blessing
[*] Second Wind
[/list]
[*] Description of some stats has been added.
[*] When you get a victory in a mission, the mission result screen will now be closed when hitting any key.
[*] Preset of graphic option has been adjusted.
[*] Game sound is turned off when the client lose its focus.

[*] Fixed a bug that animation order had mismatched when the mastery 'Forestallment' and 'Bladestorm' activated at the same time. 
[*] Fixed a bug that there was a discrepancy in selecting area and hit area of Heixing's Sweeping Fire.
[/list]

Thank you.

notes.title: [Notice] Announcement of maintenance and update. - 21th, July, 2018
notes.notes:
(This notice is written with the help of a google translator.)

Hello everyone, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

We announce the release of maintenance schedule and update detailes.

[b]Due to vacation of translation company, Next maintenance and update which was originally scheduled on Sat, 28th, July has been delayed. So next maintenance and update will be on Wed, 1st, August. We're sorry for that and thank you for the cooperation.[/b]

[b]You will not be able to access the game during maintenance.[/b]
[b]Please finish the missions completely.[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Daylight saving time is not applied.[/b]
[*] Date: 21(20)th July 2018
[*] Saturday 02:00 ~ 04:00 UTC
[*] Friday 18:00 ~ 20:00 PST 
[*] Saturday 03:00 ~ 05:00 CET
[*] Saturday 11:00 ~ 13:00 KST (GMT+9)
[/list]

[b]Update details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ordinary case 'Opening Gap - Mara Swamp of Iron Forest' has been added.
- You can try it after complete the mission 'Stop and Look Back - Pugo Shopping Street'. 
[*] Item Crafting has been added.
[list]
[*] You can craft items on worktable.
[*] Items that can be crafted vary depending on the character's professional skills.
[*] [b]Various craftable items will be added through continuous update.[/b]
[/list]

[*] Default dialog design has been renewed.
[*] Shop sells rare class weapons.
- Item price in shop has been lowered.
[*] You can now change the teammate's payroll condition in each unit's information UI at any time.
[*] Some masteries setup of Yasha has been changed.
[*] Default use count of Energy Extractor has been increased from two to three.
[*] Shape of poison cloud has been little bit stronger.
[*] Known masteries with zero count is now showed in mastery board.
[*] New Steam achievements has been added.
[list]
[*] 'Mass production' - Hundred times of item crafting.
[*] 'God's hand' - Craft ten items that is higher than epic class.
[/list]

[*] Fixed a bug that renaming function had not worked when you opened the mastery board UI.
[*] Fixed a bug that Yasha's HP had not been showed properly in specific condition.
[*] Fixed a bug that hit animation had not worked in specific condition when you hit by Marco's ability 'Eight Points Shot'.
[*] Fixed a bug that ally unit was not able to escape due to barricade and VHPD unit in the mission 'Tangled Skein - Magenta Street'.
[*] Fixed a bug that unit takes long walkaround path to avoid negative field effect when the Berserker is activated.
[*] Fixed a bug that mission objectives had not updated in the mission 'Adios. My friend. - Hansol Street'.
[*] Fixed a bug that Ray started her turn with half in the mission 'Jigsaw - Pugo Shopping Streeet'.
[*] Fixed a bug that Steam achievement 'Tactical decision' had achieved when NPC uses the wind pressure grenade.
[*] Fixed a bug that Steam achievement 'Hit 'em all!' had not achieved when you put three more enemies out of action at same time.
[*] Fixed a bug that NPC was able to be clicked while moving in Silverlining.
[*] Some typos have been fixed.

[*] Heixing costume will be provided.
[*] If you have no Albus, Sion, Irene and Anne's costumes(White series), their costumes will be provided too.
[/list]

Thank you.

(This notice is written with the help of a google translator.)

Hello everybody, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

We will have a maintenance and update as announced before.

The schedule for maintenance and update is as below.

[list]
[*] [b](Wed) 6th July 2018, Maintenance and update. (This could be changeable if translation is not ready.)[/b]
[*] [b](Sat) 6th July 2018, No maintenance and update.[/b]
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]You will not be able to access the game during maintenance.[/b]
[*] [b]Please finish the missions completely.[/b]
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Date: 6th July 2018[/b]
[*] [b]Daylight saving time is not applied.[/b]
[*] Friday 12:00 ~ 14:00 UTC
[*] Friday 04:00 ~ 06:00 PST 
[*] Friday 13:00 ~ 15:00 CET
[*] Friday 21:00 ~ 23:00 KST (GMT+9)
[/list]

[b]Update details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Scenario mission 'Intruder - Iron Forest Resource Management District' will be added.
- It will be activated on Mission Control when you complete the mission 'Adios, my friend'.
[*] Violent case 'The End of Warrior - Iron Forest Resource Management District' will be added.
- It will be activated on Mission Control when you complete the mission 'Intruder - Iron Forest'

[*] Steam achievement has been added.
[list]
[*] The formula worker - Gathering Psi-Stone hundred times.
[*] The ruler of the sky - Defeat the Big Rainbow Dorori.
[*] The black beast - Defeat the Tima 'Ash'.
[*] The end of the warrior - Complete the mission 'Roar of a beast'.
[/list]

[*] Unit's max level has expanded to 32.
[*] Some basic masteries has been changed.
[list]
[*] Albus - Responsibility
[list]
[*] Before: Next action time reduces by 25% when attack fails.
[*] After: Next action time reduces 20 and increases SP by 5 when attack is missed or blocked.
[/list]
[*] Sion - Hungry Wolf
[list]
[*] Before: [Snack] Randomly recovers a small amount of vigor or health.
[*] After: [Snack] Randomly recovers a small amount of vigor and health.
[/list]
[*] Irene - Explosive Lesser type
[list]
[*] Before: When using Savage Lesser abilities, activation of linked abilities increases by 50%.
[*] After: When using Savage Lesser abilities, activation of linked abilities increases by 50% and definitely hit the enemy.
[/list]
[*] Anne - Starry night.
[list]
[*] Before: [Weak star blessings] When the unit's HP is below 10%, Starlight Shield will be triggered.
[*] After: [Weak star blessings] When the unit's HP is below 25%, Starlight Shield will be triggered.
[/list]
[/list]

[*] Zooming-in won't work when you use dash in Strategy Camera Mode. 
[*] Neutral VHPD unit in the mission 'Tangled Skein' does not attack an enemy those who in waiting status.
[*] Option that shows Vigor on unit's HUD has been added.
[*] Usability of the mailbox has been improved.
 - Checkbox and sub menu in the mail UI are now always displayed.
[*] 'N' mark will be displayed if there's a new scenario.
[*] 'N' mark will be displayed to new item in item upgrade/salvage.
[*] If a character cannot equip the specific item, it will be highlighted by red.
[*] [b](Updated) If an enemy has an mastery that can make themself revive, the rewards(masteries, items, EXP) will be gained when the enemy has no more revived. [/b]

[*] If there's a mastery which cannot be equipped in mastery set, It is no more displayed in mastery board.
[*] Fixed a bug that wrong animation had been showed when the option 'Turning ability camera off' is checked.
[*] Fixed a bug that some event error in Silverlining. 
[*] Some typos have been fixed.
[*] If you have no Albus, Sion, Irene and Anne's costumes(White costume series), their costumes will be provided too. - Costumes can found on mailbox.

[h1]Troubleshooter now allow user-customized translation.[/h1]
You can configure additional translation files.
[list]
[*] Ex.) Adding Russian translation.
[olist]
[*] Create a [b]my_rus[/b] folder in Dictionary folder of the game folder.
[*] Copy a [b]dic_keyword.dic[/b] and [b]dic_text.dic[/b] from [b]kor[/b] or [b]eng[/b] folder and paste those to folder you created in no.1.
[*] Open the [b]Locale/locale_setting.xml[/b] of the game folder and find the [b]lang="eng"[/b] and modify it to [b]my_rus[/b] you created no.2.
[/olist]
Your translation will be applied.

[*] Ex.) Modifying translation
[list]
[*] Translation files are [b]dic_keyword.dic[/b] and [b]dic_text.dic[/b].
[*] Translation format has to be [b]#No(Tab)Source(Tab)Translation[/b].
[/list]
[/list]

[/list]

Thank you.

Hello everyone, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

The update details of this maintenance is as follows.

[list]
[*] New scenario mission 'Hansan island Unloading Dock' has been added.
- It is activated when you clear the 'Pugo Back-street' mission.
- It can be started when you accept the Issac's suggestion.
[*] New mastery set effect has been added.
- Final flame:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/e05580700e1d74af8c52f5cbb175c462089af681.png[/img]

[*] Information of 'Mastery Set Effects' is partially shown.
- a '?' will be seen on the Mastery Set Effects if 1 of the condition is missing.
- Set effect doesn't work when '?' status.
[*] Battle camera is moved to unit who is in turn when you hit 'Home' key in mission.
[*] Item drop rate of 'Wanted' enemy is increased in 'Magenta backstreet' repetitive mission.
[*] You can command your unit in Camera Strategy Mode.
[*] Camera setting is set to its original value when you disable Camera Strategy Mode.
[*] Mission control shows missions by level order.
[*] Fixed a bug that some loot boxes located out of the boundary.
[*] Fixed a bug that 'Burning the Soul' mastery didn't work.
[*] The color of Legend class item has been changed from orange to red orange.
[*] Fixed a bug that some cover information and move link are not valid.
[*] Fixed a bug that error window popup when mouse cursor is located on Irene's mastery 'Explosive Lesser type' icon.
[*] Fixed a bug that background music doesn't played properly.
[/list]

Thank you very much.

notes.title: [Notice] Patch notes for the last two months.
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31614849/f8763a48f80d496999e75abb0d86074a98c8b05e.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, this is the Troubleshooter development team.

We would like to summarize the updated contents for the last 2 months of our early access.

[b]New colleagues added[/b]
You can now recruit Irene as your third colleague. Irene uses a powerful melee battle style with control over fire property powers to take down enemies.
 
[b]Scenario missions added[/b]
: 8 scenario missions updated containing the stories on Albus and his background.
[list]
[*] Suburbs road of the border
[*] Until the day comes when we could walk together
[*] Jigsaw
[*] A spreading magenta
[*] Way up high
[*] The Pied Piper of Hamelin
[*] Fetter of the past
[/list]
 
[b]Repetitive missions added[/b]
:6 repetitive missions updated to help you on your character development and item collection.
[list]
[*] Fallen Leaves Park 
[*] Young-il Construction Site
[*] Silver Rabbit Park
[*] Road 114
[*] Pugo main street underground parking lot
[*] Back-streets of the Magenta Street
[/list]

[b]Improved convenience[/b]
[list]
[*] Option for controlling battle speed added.
[*] Option for skipping events added.
[*] Strategy mode camera added for viewing the whole map.
[*] 4K mode supported.
[*] Option for continuing the mission added. If you re-log in within 1 hour, you can continue the previous mission.
[/list]
 
[b]Fixed bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Client crashes due to usage of certain gaming equipment have been fixed.
[*] Loadings that take too long to load in some missions have been fixed.
[*] Administrator problems in some OS settings have been fixed.
[*] Troubleshooter Development Team. -
[/list]

We'll do our best. Please keep watching us!

Thank you.

notes.title: [Notice] Maintenance & Hotfix Announcement - 26.02.2018
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. 

This is the Troubleshooter development team.

We are going to have maintenance work on the Monday 26.02.2018, depending on your time zone(see below), in order to fix some bugs. Given the severity of the issue, development team decided to implement a hotfix.

[list]
[*] [b]You will not be able to access the game during maintenance.[/b]
[*] [b]Please finish the missions completely.[/b]
[/list]

[b][Maintenance Details][/b]

[b]Schedule:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Date: Monday, 26.02.2018[/b]
[*] Monday 12:00 ~ 13:00 UTC
[*] Monday 04:00 ~ 05:00 PST
[*] Monday 13:00 ~ 14:00 CET
[*] Monday 21:00 ~ 22:00 KST (GMT+9)
[/list]

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Set Mastery effect has been added.
- Generator:

- Dancing Flame:

[*] [b]Fixed a crash that happens when you use RAZER gaming gear.[/b]

notes.notes:

[*] [b]07:00 ~ 09:00 CET[/b]
[*] [b]15:00 ~ 17:00 KST (GMT+9)[/b]

[b]Update details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Two new repetitive missions have added.
- Backstreet of Magenta: Once 'Backstreet of Pugo' is completed, it will be activated in the Mission Control.
- Central Pugo: Once 'Pugo Shopping Street' is completed, it will be activated in the Mission Control.

[*] Scenario stage 'Magenta Street' has been changed.
- Enemy count decreased.
- Mission difficulty has changed from 'Extremely Hard' to 'Super hard'.

[*] New Steam achievements has been added.
[list]
[*] Under the same roof: Complete the mission 'Blue Fog Street'
[*] Pink Panther: Put Pink Horm out of action
[*] Let's twist!: Put Oliver out of action.
[*] This is not what I want: Valuate item over hundred times.
[*] Return safely to the base: Mission complete without out of action member over ten times.
[/list]

[*] 'Strategic Camera Mode' has been added.
- You can activate top view camera by pressing keyboard 'H' in mission.

[*] Pierto now sells 'Training manuals' and 'Wind pressure grenade'.
[*] Fixed a bug that axe weapons could not identified.
[*] Some wrong cover information has been fixed.
[*] Some typos have been corrected.
[/list]

Thank you very much.

notes.title: [Notice] Maintenance & Hotfix Announcement - 10.02.2018
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. This is the Troubleshooter development team.
[b]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
First of all, we would like to apologize for not being able to provide you with a new scenario stage this week.

[*] Item loss rate is as below:
[list]
[*] Poor: 10%
[*] Normal: 8%
[*] Uncommon: 6%
[*] Rare: 4%
[*] Epic: 2%
[*] Legend: 1%
[/list]

[list]
[*] Until 5 minutes after mission starts : 10 times
[*] 5 minutes ~ 10 minutes: 8 times
[*] 10 minutes ~ 15 minutes: 6 times
[*] 15 minutes ~ 20 minutes: 4 times
[*] 20 minutes ~ 25 minutes: 2 times
[*] After 25 minites: No penalty
[/list]

[list]

notes.title: [Notice] Patch note and server maintenance announcement - 2018.01.05
notes.notes:
Hello Troubleshooters.
 
We will be having our regular maintenance for contents update and server maintenance. The maintenance period will be at
 
Friday 00:00 UTC

Thursday 16:00 PST

Friday 01:00 CET

Friday 09:00 KST (GMT+9)

You will not be able to access the game during maintenance. ('Gateway server closed' message will pop-up when you try to access the game.)
 
Note:
- Please close all missions in process before the maintenance begins.
 
Patch Note:

1. New scenario mission added.
- You can now select the mission from the mission control if you have completed the ‘Road 113’ and ‘Young-il Construction Site’ missions.
 
2. Repetitive mission added.
- A repetitive mission on the ‘Road 113’ and ‘Young-il Construction Site’ will unlock when you complete the two missions.
- You can access the repetitive missions through the mission control.
- We promised there'll be 3 repetitive missions will be added. But the other one will be updated next week. We're very sorry.

3. Mission continue added.
- You will be able to continue the mission if you log-in and start the mission again within 30 minutes after the client shuts down due to errors.
- Continuing missions will not function for clients closing due to server maintenance or problems with the server.
 
4. Max level will be restricted to level 20.
- We will increase the restricted level as we increase the number of contents for the game.
- If you are above the restricted level at the moment, you will not be able to receive EXP anymore.
 
5. The ‘Unit’s Mastery Board’ will now only show masteries that can be equipped by the unit.
 
6. You can now use the mouse cursor to drag the screen.
- You can change the settings through the Options menu, the basic setting is set to WASD movement.
 
7. Scenario missions in the mission control are listed in yellow texts.
 
8. The location of the unit’s level in the mission table has been re-arranged.
 
9. New loading image added.
 
10. Some fixes on misspellings within the game.

Thank you.
